# M3-16: Dry-run report

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-16`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-16`
- Depends on: M3-15, M3-6
- Touches (exclusive while running): calibrate/ (new `report.go`), cmd/ (new file plus dispatch)
- Plan refs: §7 M3, R6, BACKLOG "What the active plan means for M3"
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`finbot dry-run-report` tells Brendan, from the local DB, how the dry-run did and how sure that number is.

## Scope
- Read-only over `decisions`, `questions`, `write_log` and the mirror. Needs only `FINBOT_DB_PATH`.
- Judged decisions: a `dry_run_check` answer, or a human-set category seen in the mirror after the decision (whichever comes first). A label must be later than the decision it judges.
- Print: first and last decision dates; decisions by method; `would_apply` count; judged count; precision for the `would_apply` band with a Wilson 95% interval; top-3 hit rate on asked rows; open and pending questions; model errors; and a final line exactly `writes: <n>`, counting `write_log` rows.
- Print `judged < 30: thin sample` when that holds.
- Category names and counts only; no ids, payees or memos.

## Out of scope
- Any YNAB or Slack call. Changing the mode.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Fixture test: precision and interval match a worked example.
- [ ] Test: a label older than its decision doesn't count.
- [ ] Test: below 30 judged prints the warning.
- [ ] Test: the output has no id, payee or memo from the fixture; `writes: 0` prints on a clean DB.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `calibrate/report.go`: `BuildDryRunReport` over a `ReportStore` interface (`*store.DB`) and `DryRunReport.Write`.
    A would_apply or asked decision is judged by the earliest label strictly later than it: an answered `dry_run_check`
    (answer = category id, name from its options) or the mirror's human-set category (`CurrentHumanCategory`, `SeenAt`;
    deleted rows don't judge; a split judges as wrong). Superseded decisions count, each judged on its own. Wilson
    interval at z = 1.96. Prints dates (local), decisions by method and outcome, `would_apply`, judged, precision with
    interval, top-3 hit rate on asked rows (from `features.top`), would_apply misses as "predicted → label" names,
    open/pending questions, model errors, the thin-sample line, and last `writes: <n>`.
  - `cmd/dry_run_report.go` + dispatch/usage in `cmd/app.go`: `finbot dry-run-report`, needs only `FINBOT_DB_PATH`
    (refuses a missing DB rather than creating one), no YNAB or Slack.
  - `store/report_read.go`: `ReportPlans` (distinct plan ids across decisions, questions, write_log), so the report needs
    no configured plan; test in `store/questions_test.go`.
  - Supervisor note, `cmd/classify.go`: a `LabelPlans` failure sets the gate to dry_run and returns
    `Result{Mode: dry_run}` with the error; `lastMode` updates whenever `res.Mode != ""`, errors included. `labelPlans`
    is a package var so tests can fail it.
- Acceptance:
  - Fixture precision + interval (9/10 → 90.0%, Wilson 59.6% to 98.2%, checked to 5e-5 against a hand-worked example):
    pass, `go test ./calibrate -run TestDryRunReport_WorkedExample`
  - Label older than (or equal to) its decision doesn't count; earliest later label wins: pass,
    `go test ./calibrate -run TestDryRunReport_LabelOlderThanDecisionDoesNotCount`
  - Below 30 judged prints `judged < 30: thin sample`; 30 doesn't: pass, `go test ./calibrate -run TestDryRunReport_ThinSampleWarning`
  - No id, payee or memo in output: pass, `go test ./calibrate -run TestDryRunReport_NoIDsPayeesOrMemos`; `writes: 0`
    on a clean DB: pass, `go test ./calibrate -run TestDryRunReport_CleanDB` and `go test ./cmd -run TestDryRunReport`
  - Supervisor note: pass, `go test ./cmd -run 'TestCategorize_LabelPlansErrorFailsClosed|TestCategorizer_LastModeFollowsFailedRunWithMode'`
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`: pass
- Deviations from brief:
  - Touched `store/` (one read query, `ReportPlans`, plus its test): "needs only FINBOT_DB_PATH" means no plan id, and
    the existing report reads are per plan.
  - "Model errors" counts decisions whose second opinion has `failed: true`. A failed primary (Jev) call leaves no
    decision and isn't persisted anywhere, so the report can't count it; the output line says so.
  - Extra warning line `would_apply judged < 30: thin sample` when total judged is ≥ 30 but the precision band's n
    isn't (the interval is on that n). `judged < 30: thin sample` prints exactly as specified.
  - Extra output: decisions by outcome and a would_apply misses list (category names and counts only).
- Follow-ups for backlog: persist primary-model failures (per run or per txn) if the report should count them.
